Definition: a Sinite, or descendant of one of the sons of Canaan
BiblicalUsage: A Sinite is a descendant of Canaan, named in the table of nations among the sons of Ham. The name appears twice, both times in lists of the peoples who filled the land. The Sinites are one of the peoples Israel will later meet in Canaan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Sinites matter because the table of nations names the peoples God knows, even those who will oppose His people.
